blogPosts.title: Why You Need a 100W GaN Charger: Say Goodbye to Bulky Laptop Bricks
blogPosts.author: David Ochieng (Gadget Reviewer)
blogPosts.excerpt: How Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology reduced charger sizes by 50% while allowing simultaneous fast charging for laptops, phones, and smartwatches.
blogPosts.content: Gallium Nitride semiconductors operate at much higher thermal efficiency than traditional silicon. This allows chargers like the Anker Prime 100W to fit in your pocket while powering a 16-inch MacBook Pro, an iPhone 16 Pro, and an Apple Watch simultaneously with zero overheating...
